gameplayEstimates.capacityBasis: Forty-eight nonoverlapping150mm cargo seeds inside the measured extended envelope plus documented expandable net, not volume divided by fuel count.
gameplayEstimates.hoodMapping: Exported terminal roller tangent approx53.1deg; bake+24.9deg to shared78deg neutral and use38deg operational subset. Packet80deg total travel is not an absolute shot-angle range.
gameplayEstimates.scatterBasis: Qualitative physical launch-uncertainty estimate, slightly broader than Icarus profile, not a TBA/Statbotics hit probability or forced hit/miss rating.
gameplayEstimates.hopperDynamics: Shared full-size local sphere solver; Space folds the actual pivot as cargo empties, Intake/Reverse extends it, and the expanding horizontal hopper stays out. Net is an estimated containment envelope, not individual simulated strands.
gameplayEstimates.climbing: No identified hook mechanism in inspected export hierarchy/batched surfaces. Team packet describes a real pivoting climber; capability remains disabled in this simulator.
